name: Multi-Scale Coherence Transfer Law
purpose: Define how coherence transfers across emergent scale-like continuation organization layers.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Local stabilized continuation patterns may contribute to larger coherent structures, while larger structures may constrain local continuation through accessibility, admissibility, and reinforcement feedback.

formal.scale_like_layer: S_k := admissibility-bounded organization layer induced by coherent reconciliation structure
formal.coherence_metric: Coh(S_i, S_j) := F(accessibility_alignment, reinforcement_overlap, arbitration_compatibility, finite_budget_compatibility, invariant_preservation)
formal.upward_transfer_condition: Transfer(S_i → S_j) occurs when local coherence reinforces a higher-order structure above threshold.
formal.downward_constraint_condition: Constrain(S_j → S_i) occurs when higher-order coherence narrows local admissible options.
formal.scale_decoupling_condition: Decouple(S_i, S_j) occurs when accessibility or budget incompatibility blocks coherence transfer.
formal.nonprimitive_scale_clause: Scale-like layers are emergent strata, not primitive background levels.
formal.no_global_synchronization: Coherence transfer does not imply global synchronization across all loci.
